review.basis: Independent solve: platelet primary-hemostasis actions are adhesion to exposed subendothelium, ADP/TXA2 release that amplifies aggregation, TXA2-mediated local vasoconstriction, and provision of a procoagulant phospholipid surface (the functional PF3 concept). B4 KP03 owns adhesion/aggregation/release/phospholipid platform; KP02 explicitly owns platelet TXA2-mediated vasoconstriction. Current uses the functional phospholipid-surface wording rather than the literal PF3 label.
